static.solution:
SOLUTION
Since \displaystyle g(x) = \frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1} = \frac{(x-1)(x+1)}{x^2+1} the x-intercepts are x= \pm 1; the y-intercept is y = -1/1 =-1; the horizontal asymptote is y=1; there are no vertical asymptotes.
